title: The 10 Best Cordless Lawn Mowers
subtitle: Battery-powered push and self-propelled lawn mowers, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A cordless lawn mower starts with a button, needs no gas or oil changes and is much quieter than a gas mower. We ranked 10 best-sellers from Greenworks, EGO, WORX and MZK on rating, review volume and features (a 21-inch deck, self-propelled drive, a brushless motor and two batteries). Size the deck and battery to your lawn.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

avoid.name: Litheli Electric Lawn Mower Cordless, 13 in Cutting Width, for 1300 Sq. Ft.
avoid.flag: Rated for 1,300 sq ft per charge
avoid.verdict: The listing itself says it mows about 1,300 sq ft per charge, a tiny fraction of what the mowers we rank cover, and it's rated 3.7 stars.
reasons: It 'can mow up to 1,300 sq. ft.' on a full charge, about 1/33 of an acre. The Greenworks 25322 is rated for up to 1/3 acre (about 14,500 sq ft).
Its model number (EGT010172) and part number (U20LM00-0A110) don't match, which makes parts and blades harder to find.
It's rated 3.7 stars on 982 reviews, the lowest of the mowers we looked at with more than a few dozen reviews.

buyers_guide.q: What deck size do I need?
buyers_guide.a: 16 to 17 inches suits small lawns and tight spaces. 21 inches is the standard for medium and large lawns and cuts the job down by about a quarter.
Makers quote coverage on flat, dry grass. Greenworks rates its 16-inch 40V model at 1/3 acre and its 80V self-propelled at 1/2 acre. Thick or wet grass cuts that a lot; a second battery helps.
On slopes or lawns over about 1/4 acre, yes. Self-propelled mowers drive the wheels so you only steer.
Brushless motors run cooler and get more mowing from each charge. They're standard on the 60V and 80V Greenworks and EGO mowers here.
Mower batteries are expensive. Pick a platform (EGO, Greenworks, WORX) whose trimmers and blowers you'll also use, so one charger and set of packs runs everything.
